chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him) when he set out to fight the people of Basra
[In it is the wisdom of the sending of the messengers, then he mentions his virtue and condemns the rebels]

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْبَصْرَةِ: The people of Basra, referring to the opposing forces in the Battle of Jamal
key_terms.الْخَارِجِينَ: The rebels or those who went out in rebellion, a technical term often used for Ali's opponents in Basra
key_terms.حِكْمَةُ مَبْعَثِ الرُّسُلِ: The wisdom of the sending of the messengers, a thematic element within the sermon

ai.seo_question: What is the context and content of Imam Ali's sermon when setting out for the Battle of Basra?
ai.summary: This heading introduces Imam Ali’s (AS) address to the troops of Basra, framing the Battle of Jamal not merely as a political conflict but as a continuation of the prophetic mission to establish justice. By invoking the wisdom of the prophets, he contextualizes his own leadership as a divine mandate while critiquing the Khawarij and Qurra' for their deviation from the Quranic path. This sets the theological stage for his subsequent detailed refutation of their claims in the sermon.
